correctness.rationale: Every face of the exactly specified 20-vertex simplicial complex is enumerated and every augmented boundary composition checked. Every signed fixed-face Lefschetz trace is independently checked and its irreducible character decomposition matches exactly.

value.rationale: The exact D5 matching complex has already motivated a published connectivity/homology table. Its missing complete rational S5 × C2 representation and degree-three homology rank are natural, nontrivial invariants: the 2-class is relabeling invariant but transpose anti-invariant, while the 13-dimensional 3-homology splits into genuinely distinct 4-, 4-, and 5-dimensional Specht modules. Neither a scalar Betti number nor full-board module determines this structure; naturalness precedes computation, and the exact finite answer is reusable in further symmetry and relative-complex analyses.
